note: Cloud storage-class plan. Applied only when MINIO_APPLY_LIFECYCLE=1 and the endpoint accepts the rule. Unset apply exits 0 and prints that nothing was sent. Local compose MinIO has no remote tier, so a real apply there fails closed. Self-hosted hot SSD to cold HDD copy is scripts/object-tier.mjs (MINIO_APPLY_TIER=1) and does not mark this GLACIER rule as applied.
